clauses.title: Parties and term
clauses.summary: Agreement between NBCS (seller) and ORX (buyer), effective 2025-03-01, evergreen.

clauses.title: Billing period
clauses.summary: Monthly; calls attributed to a period by start time in UTC.

clauses.title: Charge rounding
clauses.summary: Line amount = billable minutes x rate, rounded half-up to 2 decimals per invoice line.

clauses.title: Invoicing
clauses.summary: Invoice issued within 5 days after period end, with summary by destination; CDR detail on request.

clauses.title: Payment
clauses.summary: Payment due 30 days from invoice date.

clauses.title: Rate decks
clauses.summary: Seller prices from the NB-VOICE rate deck family; decks may be full or partial.

clauses.title: Change indicators
clauses.summary: Every changed row carries a change flag and effective date.

clauses.title: Rate increase notice
clauses.summary: An increase or new destination takes effect no earlier than the first full UTC day starting at least 7 days after the notice is sent; until then the previous rate applies.

clauses.title: Rate decreases
clauses.summary: A decrease takes effect on the stated effective date, with no notice period.

clauses.title: Dispute window
clauses.summary: Buyer may dispute in writing within 14 days of the invoice date.

clauses.title: Minimum dispute
clauses.summary: Disputes below USD 50.00 per invoice are not accepted.

clauses.title: Undisputed amounts
clauses.summary: Buyer pays the undisputed portion by the due date.

clauses.title: Dispute evidence
clauses.summary: Notice states billed rate, correct rate, period, account ID and supporting CDR detail.

clauses.title: Escalation
clauses.summary: Disputes unresolved after 30 days escalate to commercial management.

clauses.title: Credits
clauses.summary: Upheld disputes are credited on the next invoice.
